maya: Quick follow-up to validator DSL RFC — need a pragmatic plan for safetensors streaming verification + warmup telemetry before next canary.

arjun: Tradeoff: inline verify latency vs silent corruption risk. Need low-overhead approach.

tom: Suggest: sync-verify head+tail (cheap), lazy-verify body, background verifier to promote shards to VERIFIED. Manifest carries per-chunk sha256 + lazy_allowed flag.

jen: Agreed. Add telemetry events: STREAM_CHUNK_UNVERIFIED, CHUNK_VERIFIED_LATE, HOTSTART_VERIFIED_MISS, VERIFY_RETRY. Keep schema tight to avoid cardinality.

luis: Background verifier must use low-prio CPU/GPU and check eviction lease before promoting. Also add sampling mode for new uploads (5-10% sync checks).

arjun: mmap fallback: if mmap yields partial pages, gate promotion on deterministic re-reads. On corruption: immediate re-fetch from origin and fail request if re-fetch fails. No silent degrade.

tom: Short-term plan: update manifest header, loader: head/tail sync checks, per-node background verifier, telemetry hooks.

maya: Owners: tom manifest+loader, jen telemetry/dashboards, luis verifier, arjun fallback semantics. I'll draft RFC follow-up and canary timeline.

ops-bot: deploy:loader-v2 canary started on cluster-ml-7 (build: loader-v2-2026-03-21). Monitor #eng-oncall. :rocket:

maya: Thanks team :thumbsup:
